overview: November 2026 mixes simulation-based inference and generative surrogates with survey-scale data products. Normalizing flows and neural operators target tomographic N(z), weak-lensing fields, MHD turbulence and rotating neutron stars; equivariant spherical Fourier operators and differentiable JAX/PyTorch tools extend methods. Euclid DR1 strong-lens catalogues, Survey of Surveys DR3 stellar parameters, COSMIO cross-survey imputation and the FAIR Universe weak-lensing challenge provide benchmarks and catalogues. LLM agents and foundation-model interpretability appear in literature extraction and provenance-checked pipelines, while CNN classifiers address LISA, BNS early warning and solar forecasting.
